title: Stop the Bleeding — Repo/Production Drift and Urgent Security Exposure
priority_note: Do first. Small and low-risk by design. Roadmap: 'Phase 0 — Stop the bleeding (small, low-risk, do first)'. Item 5 below was added during contract-kit preparation (2026-09-15) because of its severity; it was not in the roadmap doc's original four-item list.
audit_status_note: A section-by-section bug audit of the live production source (vps/daveai-ui-v6.html, brain_llm.py, CSS, and infra scripts) produced 133 candidate findings; 83 were independently confirmed real. The other 50 are NOT confirmed-false — they are pending re-verification after an unrelated rate-limit interruption stopped that re-check pass partway through. Treat any finding not explicitly marked confirmation_status='confirmed' or 'verified-in-this-contract' below as unresolved, not cleared. No consolidated ledger of all 133 findings exists in this repository as of 2026-09-15; the items under known_findings here are only the ones specifically flagged for this phase.

roadmap_sections: §6 Decisions needed (item 1 is out of this contract's scope — see CT-005)

summary: Four low-risk repo-hygiene fixes that stop the repository from actively lying about what's live on daveai.tech, plus one urgent, narrowly-scoped security lockdown, before any feature work (Phase 1+) begins on the same files.
background: The repo's copy of the production chat/menu/games surface has already drifted from what daveai.tech actually serves, in a way that has caused a real regression before: the roadmap doc records that the repo's catalog still contains a rejected, broken game entry that production had already replaced, and that if this repo's catalog were ever redeployed as-is it would put the broken page back in front of users. Separately, a fresh diff on 2026-09-15 found the repo's vps/daveai-ui-v6.html differs from live production by 64 lines of real content (an external-launch guard, a cache-bust version bump, and hardening attributes), meaning the repo is currently the stale copy, not production. A third file, vps/DAVEAI_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md, asserts an invariant (that an archival HTML copy must stay byte-identical to the main file) that a same-day hash check already proved false. None of this has anywhere to land automatically — production is patched by hand-running shell scripts that install straight onto the VPS, with no step that pulls the resulting state back into git. This contract closes those four gaps. A fifth item was added when preparing this contract kit: a follow-up bug audit reported an unauthenticated admin panel that leaks internal infra details, including the raw VPS IP — a live, exploitable exposure independent of any feature work, which belongs in this 'stop the bleeding' phase rather than waiting for Phase 1.

steps: Read docs/DAVEAI_DEEP_AUDIT_ROADMAP_20260915.md in full (§0, §1, §5 Phase 0 at minimum) and this contract in full before touching anything.
For item 1: fetch the live production catalog behavior (or ask for it) to determine the actual correct replacement entry for line 43 — do not invent one.

For item 2: regenerate the production-vs-repo diff yourself (`git show HEAD:vps/daveai-ui-v6.html` vs. a fresh fetch of the live page) and apply exactly the real content differences, leaving Cloudflare-injected script noise out.
For item 3: read vps/DAVEAI_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md in full, re-run the three-way SHA-256 comparison yourself, and correct the doc to state what is actually true today, with the hashes as evidence.
For item 4: add a concrete pull-back step (automated if feasible, a checklist item appended to script output/README if not) to the vps/patches/*.sh workflow.

For item 5: locate the real admin panel and its auth gap directly on the live VPS (do not assume this repo contains its source); apply the narrowest fix that requires authentication and stops the infra-detail leak, without touching unrelated admin functionality.
Gather required_evidence for every item before writing any completion report.
Check every definition_of_done line item against your own evidence before declaring any of them done.
required_evidence: For item 1: the exact diff of vps/daveai-project-catalog.json (before/after), plus a citation (screenshot, curl output, or direct confirmation) of what production actually serves for the Checkers entry today.
For item 2: the exact regenerated diff between the repo copy and a fresh curl of live production, and the resulting diff of vps/daveai-ui-v6.html after your fix, showing the gap closed.
For item 3: the three SHA-256 hashes (repo-main, live production, archival copy) computed by you, plus the exact wording change made to vps/DAVEAI_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md.
For item 4: the exact diff/addition to the relevant vps/patches/*.sh script(s) or their documentation.

For item 5: the exact request/response (e.g. curl output, with any secret values redacted) demonstrating the panel required no authentication before your fix, and a second request/response demonstrating it is rejected (401/403) after your fix.
A restated definition_of_done checklist with each line marked done/blocked/not-attempted and an evidence pointer for every 'done' line.
reporting_requirements: State exact counts: how many of the 5 items were fixed with evidence, how many were attempted and blocked (say why), and how many were not attempted.
Every item claimed fixed must cite a required_evidence artifact by file path, not a narrative description.
Never use a forbidden_claim_patterns phrase to describe this contract's outcome unless the exact proof command+output is quoted directly next to it.
If you find additional drift or security issues outside these 5 items while working, record them (file + line + description) and hand them off rather than silently expanding this contract's scope.

[ ] Item 2: the regenerated repo-vs-production diff of vps/daveai-ui-v6.html is empty (or only Cloudflare-injected noise remains), with the before/after diff attached as evidence.
[ ] Item 3: vps/DAVEAI_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md states an accurate, hash-verified claim about the archival copy, with the three hashes attached as evidence.
[ ] Item 4: a concrete pull-back step exists in the vps/patches/*.sh workflow (automated or checklist), with the diff attached as evidence.

[ ] Item 5: the admin panel identified in F-P0-05 requires authentication and no longer returns internal infra details (including the VPS IP) to an unauthenticated request, with before/after request evidence attached.

failure_policy.if_blocked: Stop. Document exactly what is blocking you (e.g. cannot reach the VPS, cannot confirm the correct Checkers replacement entry) and why. Do not guess, silently skip the item, or mark it done anyway.
failure_policy.if_partially_done: Report exact done/blocked/not-attempted counts against the 5 items above. Partial completion is a legitimate, honest outcome — an inflated claim is not.

rollback_plan: Before installing any change to a live path (nginx config, brain backend, or /var/www/agentic-website), snapshot the current file(s) to a timestamped backup directory, following the existing pattern in vps/patches/deploy-accessibility-contract-20260725.sh (backup → install → verify with sha256sum/curl → trap-based rollback to the backup on any verification failure). Never install to production without a verified rollback path already staged. Repo-only changes (items 1, 3, 4) should go through a normal branch + PR rather than a direct push to the default branch.
